say:0:1631107001:0.text: As your hand rests on the statue, an indescribable sensation travels up your fingertips. It feels as though something has awakened.
say:0:1631107001:0.source_cn: 当你将手放在雕像上时，一股难以言喻的感觉顺着指尖传来—...
say:0:1631107001:0.male: As your hand rests on the statue, an indescribable sensation travels up your fingertips. It feels as though something has awakened.
say:0:1631107001:0.female: As your hand rests on the statue, an indescribable sensation travels up your fingertips. It feels as though something has awakened.

say:1:1631107002:0.text: A voice, faint as spider silk in the wind, echoes clearly inside your mind.
say:1:1631107002:0.source_cn: 一个声音如风中蛛丝般微弱，却清晰地直接在你脑海中响起。
say:1:1631107002:0.male: A voice, faint as spider silk in the wind, echoes clearly inside your mind.
say:1:1631107002:0.female: A voice, faint as spider silk in the wind, echoes clearly inside your mind.

narration:6:1631107005:0.text: The moment you nod, a powerful force pulls you in. The world blurs and twists around you.
narration:6:1631107005:0.source_cn: 在你点头的瞬间，一股强大的牵引力攫住了你, 周围的景物...
narration:6:1631107005:0.male: The moment you nod, a powerful force pulls you in. The world blurs and twists around you.
narration:6:1631107005:0.female: The moment you nod, a powerful force pulls you in. The world blurs and twists around you.

narration:7:1631107006:0.text: When your senses return, you find yourself somewhere completely unfamiliar.
narration:7:1631107006:0.source_cn: 当你的意识再次清晰，发现自己已身处一个完全陌生的地方。
narration:7:1631107006:0.male: When your senses return, you find yourself somewhere completely unfamiliar.
narration:7:1631107006:0.female: When your senses return, you find yourself somewhere completely unfamiliar.
